purpose: library: the cell as the basic building block of living things — trillions of cells in the human body; organelles as specialised structures; the page's alphabetical tour of major human cell parts with functions: cytoplasm/cytosol, cytoskeleton, endoplasmic reticulum, Golgi apparatus, mitochondria, nucleus, ribosomes, vesicles and peroxisomes and more, each with its job; cells' shared DNA and their specialisation. Fits a compare table of organelle × function, quiz cards with predict-then-reveal, and a concept map of the cell parts. Carries labelled cell-diagram figures (not stored; a future diagram engine could use the real page images).
